const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Visual controller for one RoboCasa GR1 tabletop episode.
+
+Only Robot.spec(), RGB/depth camera observations and proprioception from the
+eai-standard client are used.  Pixel-to-world projection follows each response's
+OpenGL camera calibration; no simulator object state or task success is queried.
+This file is kept interactive so each physical contact can be inspected before
+the next action is sent.
+"""
+import sys, time, json
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+DT = spec["control_dt"]
+CAM = ["egoview", "robot0_agentview_left", "robot0_agentview_right"]
+BASE_R = np.array([[0., -1., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
+BASE_T = np.array([2.65, -2.175, 0.97])
+
+def observe(cameras=CAM, depth=True, folder=None):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="none")
+    if folder:
+        o.save(folder)
+    return o
+
+obs0 = observe(cameras=list(spec["cameras"]), folder="/app/output/initial")
+layout = obs0.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+pv = np.asarray(obs0.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+idx = {n:i for i,n in enumerate(layout)}
+
+def _pose_from_proprio(side):
+    return np.array([pv[idx[f"cmd_{side}_{c}"]] for c in ("x","y","z","rx","ry","rz")], dtype=float)
+
+R0 = _pose_from_proprio("right")
+L0 = _pose_from_proprio("left")
+RH0 = pv[[idx[f"cmd_right_{c}"] for c in ("little","ring","middle","index","thumb_flexion","thumb_rotation")]]
+LH0 = pv[[idx[f"cmd_left_{c}"] for c in ("little","ring","middle","index","thumb_flexion","thumb_rotation")]]
+last = np.r_[R0, L0, RH0, LH0]
+
+def world_to_base(p):
+    return BASE_R.T @ (np.asarray(p, dtype=float) - BASE_T)
+
+def base_to_world(p):
+    return BASE_R @ np.asarray(p, dtype=float) + BASE_T
+
+def pixel_to_world(o, camera, u, v, z=None):
+    """Project an RGB pixel using that response's CV intrinsics and GL extrinsic."""
+    c = o.meta["cameras"][camera]
+    K = np.asarray(c["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    if z is None:
+        z = float(o.depth[camera][0, int(v), int(u)])
+    x = (float(u)-K[0,2]) / K[0,0] * z
+    y_cv = (float(v)-K[1,2]) / K[1,1] * z
+    p_gl = np.array([x, -y_cv, -z, 1.])
+    return (np.asarray(c["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float) @ p_gl)[:3]
+
+def _current():
+    global obs0, pv, last
+    obs0 = observe()
+    pv = np.asarray(obs0.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return obs0
+
+def send(right=None, left=None, rh=None, lh=None, seconds=1.0, label=""):
+    """Move along a bounded Cartesian ramp, then hold the requested targets."""
+    global last
+    target = last.copy()
+    if right is not None: target[0:6] = np.asarray(right, float)
+    if left is not None: target[6:12] = np.asarray(left, float)
+    if rh is not None: target[12:18] = np.asarray(rh, float)
+    if lh is not None: target[18:24] = np.asarray(lh, float)
+    n = max(1, int(round(float(seconds) / DT)))
+    # Smooth setpoint motion; use several seconds for object approaches.
+    alpha = np.linspace(1. / n, 1., n)[:, None]
+    rows = last[None, :] + alpha * (target-last)[None, :]
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=DT, interpolate="hold", cameras=CAM,
+                   video="none", note=label)
+    last = target
+    print("ACTION", label, "steps", res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+          "time_left", res.meta.get("time_left_s"), "done", res.meta.get("done"))
+    return res
+
+def wait_obs(seconds=0.0, folder=None):
+    global obs0, pv
+    obs0 = r.get_obs(cameras=CAM, seconds=seconds, include_depth=True, video="none")
+    pv = np.asarray(obs0.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    if folder: obs0.save(folder)
+    print("OBS", obs0.meta.get("control_steps"), "time_left", obs0.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    return obs0
+
+def info():
+    print("right target", last[0:6], "left target", last[6:12])
+    print("right ee world", pv[[idx["eef_right_x"],idx["eef_right_y"],idx["eef_right_z"]]])
+    print("left ee world", pv[[idx["eef_left_x"],idx["eef_left_y"],idx["eef_left_z"]]])
+    print("hands", last[12:18], last[18:24])
+    print("status", r.status())
+
+print("READY", json.dumps({"dt": DT, "cameras": spec["cameras"], "time_left_s": obs0.meta.get("time_left_s")}, indent=1))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
